description: Review a recommendation from your inbox. Accept to adopt as-is, reject to dismiss, or adapt to modify the claim for your organization's context. Requires API key.

action.description: Action to take: accept, reject, or adapt

adapted_rule.description: Modified rule text (required when action is 'adapt')

adapted_why.description: Modified reasoning text (optional when action is 'adapt')

notes.description: Optional review notes explaining your decision

name: review_recommendation
